scenes.say: Is accuracy always the best metric? What happens when your classes are uneven?

scenes.label: Imbalance
scenes.sub: One class dominates the dataset, causing misleading results.
scenes.say: Class imbalance means one group shows up way more than others. This can make your metrics look better than they really are.
Accuracy can fool you if the data is skewed. Metrics like F1-score or ROC-AUC give a clearer picture.

rows.b: Balance classes by adding or removing data
Give more importance to rare classes

scenes.say: To handle imbalance, I resample, tweak class weights, or switch to better metrics.

scenes.question: Is accuracy enough for fraud detection?
scenes.right: No, because most transactions are legit, so accuracy hides model weaknesses. F1 or ROC-AUC is better.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Is accuracy enough for fraud detection? Nope. Since almost all transactions are legit, accuracy hides model weaknesses. F1-score or ROC-AUC works better.
